name: Wynn's Grain and Spice
old_description: Since 1952, Wynn’s Grain & Spice has remained family-owned and true to its Alabama roots. We remain steadfast to our commitments to quality and to treating our partners like family.
about:
Wynn's Grain & Spice was founded in 1952 in Montgomery, Alabama, and has remained family-owned through three generations. The business began in a home kitchen when a founder known as Wynn, with the backing of a trusted friend, developed a blend of grains and spices that captured Southern flavor. The company still operates from its Alabama base, now in Wetumpka, and continues to honor the original recipes.

The company manufactures a range of dry and liquid products for the foodservice industry, including chicken breadings and batters, marinades and dips, all-natural and conventional seasoning blends, and fryer maintenance chemicals such as Filter Fresh and Fryer Fresh. Production is geared toward wholesale distribution, serving customers across the United States with a focus on prepared chicken programs.

Primary customers are foodservice operators, from independent fried-chicken restaurants to larger institutional kitchens that run prepared chicken programs. The firm positions itself as a consultative partner, offering operational expertise alongside its product line to help clients maximize yield and consistency.

Wynn's emphasizes its family heritage and time-tested formulations as differentiators, stating that its blends are crafted to please discerning palates and that its consultative approach extends beyond simple supply to include fryer management support and program development.
